author: reek
body: Citing ShellBuild beside ShellTypes is the whole reproducer. The CHECK-KEEP address memo was sized from the surviving binding count while the checker materializes a distinct type structure per mention, so on this unit the table saturated, the deep copy degraded to unmemoized, and the keep deck overflowed its floor into the check scratch it was still reading. The compiler died in a general-protection fault with no diagnostic of any kind, which is why this test exists: the crash was invisible to every harness that counts error lines. The loop below keeps the cited graph reachable so dead-code elimination cannot shrink the unit.
